symptoms: Inspiratory stridor, barking cough, hoarseness, chest retractions.
Severity: Mild, Moderate, Severe, Imminent Respiratory Failure.

management_steps.details: Oral steroids (Dexamethasone). No need for observation in EC. Discharge home with advice.
Oral steroids. Adrenaline neb 0.5ml/kg 1:1000 (max 5ml). Can repeat after 10-15 mins if still symptomatic. Observe in EC for 2-4 hours.
Oral/IM/IV steroids. Adrenaline neb 0.5ml/kg 1:1000 (max 5ml) repeat as required. Refer to Paeds for admission to PICU or Paeds High Care.
Manage ABC, Give Ox, Adrenaline neb 5ml 1:1000, IV/IM steroids. Call for help. Prepare to intubate with RSI. Repeat adrenaline neb as required.

warnings: Sit child on parent's lap — minimal handling approach to avoid precipitating complete airway obstruction.
